features.name: Washington Park Dog Park
features.description: Washington Park Dog Park is a 12,000-square-foot fenced off-leash area with synthetic canine turf, pea gravel, granite boulders, benches, a play creek and drinking-water spouts for people and dogs.

details.positionQuality: Reviewed center point of the operator-identified fenced dog-park footprint on the east side of Washington Park
details.imageAlt: Fenced Washington Park Dog Park with dogs, boulders, benches and the neighborhood beyond
